provenance.variant_transform: Rename module; replace each else if (clr_i)/(ena_i) with else if (!(!clr_i))/else if (!(!ena_i)). Original RTL unchanged.

variant_equivalence.command: yosys -Q -T -p 'read_verilog -sv examples/heldout_queue/rtl/queue.sv examples/heldout_queue/rtl/queue_variant.sv; proc; opt; memory; opt; async2sync; opt; equiv_make queue queue_variant equiv; hierarchy -top equiv; equiv_simple; equiv_induct -seq 4; equiv_status -assert'
variant_equivalence.async_note: async2sync is applied to both designs for the sequential SAT proof; both original RTL event sets are separately retained and compared

preflight_seed: 2 reset cycles, 4 idle cycles; no clear/read/write
separate_reachability_validation: Independent run appends write-only then read-only cycles; all 24 selected counters have positive hits; actions excluded from model seed
